commits.message: Padding pays its sides in full and draws content left no column as nothing, as Rich's does, so a narrow Markdown code block draws only its padding rows (rich-unfiled-791c.sk1p)

Markdown draws headings, rules and link URLs in Rich 15's styles, each heading level from its own key (rich-unfiled-791c.n0a3) (#463)

* Markdown draws headings, rules and link URLs in Rich 15's styles, each heading level from its own key (rich-unfiled-791c.n0a3)

markdown.h2-h4, hr and link_url now match rich.default_styles in Rich 15,
and h5/h6 exist. headingStyle read markdown.h${min(level, 4)}, so a theme
setting h5 or h6 did nothing; it now reads markdown.h${level}, as Rich's
Heading reads markdown.{tag}. A test pins h1-h6, the rule and both link
URL forms against Rich 15's rendered segments.

Keys Rich defines that this renderer never reads (h7, paragraph, text,
emph, code_block, list, h1.border) are not added. markdown.kbd is a real
gap in behaviour, filed as rich-unfiled-791c.k2zi.

* Heading level is typed 1-6 at the parser, every level's own key and the rule's are pinned, and the docs name them (rich-unfiled-791c.n0a3)

* HeadingLevel's comment sits on it and names setext headings; MdToken keeps its own (rich-unfiled-791c.n0a3)
